# Shyena

> Shyena is an AI agent assurance platform for testing, evaluating and security-assessing conversational, voice and agentic AI before production. Its product architecture is Nexus (system-map intelligence, powered by CIS), Vera (quality and evaluation, powered by ECAAP), and Chakra (adversarial/security assurance).

Shyena runs agentic test journeys against supported live agent surfaces, evaluates behavior with deterministic assertions and AI evaluation, preserves runtime evidence, and turns the evidence chain into a release verdict. Product names shown publicly are Nexus, Vera and Chakra; CIS and ECAAP are underlying technology layers.

## Products

- [Nexus](https://shyena.eu/nexus): understand the agent through structural system-map intelligence, flow discovery, conditions, orchestration and high-coverage test specification generation.
- [Vera](https://shyena.eu/vera): evaluate conversational and voice AI using agentic execution, LLM-judged quality, deterministic checks, orchestration evaluation and release gating.
- [Chakra](https://shyena.eu/chakra): adversarial and security assurance for agentic AI.

## Platform assurance lifecycle

Test → Evaluate → Attack → Prove → Verdict.

Every release signal should be traceable to the underlying execution, conversation, finding, affected component and evidence.

## Pricing

- [Pricing](https://shyena.eu/pricing): SaaS platform subscription with included assurance/security consumption, contracted overage rates, and separately priced professional services such as pilots, training, custom development and bespoke framework adapters.
